description: This file defines functions and logic for generating and sanitizing an OpenAPI (Swagger) specification for a Node.js Express application. It attempts to load a prebuilt OpenAPI JSON file, sanitizes it, and falls back to generating the spec from JSDoc annotations if necessary. It exports a function getBaseOpenApiSpec() for retrieving the base API specification.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Generates an OpenAPI specification from JSDoc annotations in source files.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes an OpenAPI document by ensuring valid path keys and required fields.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main function that returns the OpenAPI spec, preferring a prebuilt JSON file and falling back to JSDoc generation.
